password.title: Change password
password.changeHint: Enter your current password, then choose a new one. You will stay signed in on this device; all your other devices will be signed out.
password.policyHint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.

requirements.title: What the new password needs
requirements.match: The same new password typed again in Confirm
requirements.different: A password that is not the one you use now
requirements.breached: Not a password other people can already guess
requirements.reused: Not a password you already used on this account

why.length: This password is too short. Add characters until it has at least 8.
why.upper: Add a capital letter, such as A or B.
why.lower: Add a small letter, such as a or b.
why.number: Add a number, such as 2 or 9.

errors.mismatch: The confirmation does not match the new password. Type the new password again in Confirm new password.
errors.same: The new password is the same as the one you use now. Choose a different password.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. The account is temporarily locked; try again later.
errors.failed: Could not change the password. Please try again.
errors.reused: You used this password recently on this account. Choose one you have not used here before.
errors.breached: This password has appeared in stolen password lists, so other people may already know it. Choose a different password — not a name, a common word, or a year.
errors.reauth: For your security, sign in again or use the emailed link to change your password.
